shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.brand_info: Your logo, slogan, short description, favicon and social links come from Shopify admin > Settings > Brand. Colours and type are fixed by the design system.
shopping.enable_ajax_cart: Add to bag without leaving the product page
shopping.shop_all_collection_info: Used by every "shop all" link: the hero default, empty bag, 404, empty collections and breadcrumbs. Leave empty to use Shopify's built-in /collections/all.

product_cards.name: Product cards
product_cards.show_second_image: Show a second product image on hover

info.eyebrow: A short label above the heading. Four words at most.
info.image_alt: Alt text comes from the image. Edit it in Content > Files.

contact.heading: A conversation, naturally.
contact.text: Questions about a provision, an order, or the way we do things? We would be glad to hear from you.

faq.answer: One animal ingredient, clearly named. Each product page lists its ingredient, origin and processing.
faq.question: What does single-ingredient mean?

manifesto.heading: A shorter ingredient list. A clearer connection to the natural world.

newsletter.heading: A note, now and then.
newsletter.text: New provisions, stories of origin, and things worth sharing. A considered correspondence.

password.heading: Something worth waiting for.
password.text: A considered collection of single-ingredient provisions. Leave your email to hear when we open.

product.purchase_note: Shipping and any applicable taxes are calculated at checkout.

collection.name: Collection
collection.menu_info: Links shown above the products, e.g. All provisions, From the land, From the sea. Without a menu, the product count shows instead.

contact.name: Contact
contact.show_email_info: Uses the sender email from Shopify admin > Settings > Notifications.
contact.text_info: Shown when the page itself has no content.

faq.name: Questions and answers
faq.heading_info: Leave empty when the page introduction already titles the questions.
faq.question: Question

featured_collection.name: Selected provisions
featured_collection.collection_info: The link beside the heading uses this collection's title.

footer.name: Footer
footer.brand_info: The wordmark, description, slogan and social links come from Shopify admin > Settings > Brand. Each column heading is the menu's title.
footer.support_menu_info: Social links from Settings > Brand are listed under this menu.

image_with_text.name: Image and story
image_with_text.anchor_info: Lets a menu link scroll here, e.g. /#our-approach

origins.name: Origins
origins.collection_info: The card uses the collection's title, description and image unless you override them below.

product.name: Product
product.eyebrow_info: Shown when a product has no product type.
product.show_dynamic_checkout_info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay and other enabled wallets.

recommendations.name: Product recommendations
recommendations.intent_info: Complementary products are set up in the Search & Discovery app. Sold-out products are never recommended.
